skill.name: flux-2-klein
skill.description: Use Flux 2 Klein on RunComfy for fast image generation, model routing, prompt structuring, and reference-image guidance. The skill documents CLI setup, 4B and 9B variant choices, safe output handling, and known model limits.
skill.summary: Guide Flux 2 Klein image generation through RunComfy with fast and polished workflows.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most command hits are markdown backticks, endpoint names, or prompt examples. Real risk remains because users install and run RunComfy, send data to an external API, and store a token locally. No prompt injection language was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and global install
remediation.suggestion: Avoid global install instructions where possible. Prefer pinned CLI versions and tell users to review commands before running them.
Add clearer privacy language before invocation examples. State which prompt, reference, token, and output data reaches RunComfy.

remediation.issue: Token persistence in hidden home directory
remediation.suggestion: Explain token file permissions, rotation, and revocation. Recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for ephemeral CI usage.

content.value_statement: Fast image work needs clear model choices, prompt structure, and safe CLI handling. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Flux 2 Klein on RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use the 4B or 9B Flux 2 Klein endpoint.
Provides RunComfy CLI invocation patterns for concepting, polished output, and wide posters.
Documents prompt structure for subject, scene, style, lighting, and camera details.
Describes reference image use for style transfer and guided composition.
Lists model limits for resolution, aspect ratio, prompt length, and embedded text.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account and either CLI login or a token.
Sends prompts and reference assets to RunComfy's hosted model service.
Does not self-host Flux 2 Klein or grant model access by itself.
Flux 2 Klein is not best for 4K output or heavy in-image text.

use_cases.title: Rapid product concepting
use_cases.description: Explore product visuals quickly with 4B, then move selected concepts to 9B for polish.

use_cases.title: Brand style exploration
use_cases.description: Use aligned reference images to test visual directions for campaigns and asset packs.

use_cases.title: Model routing decisions
use_cases.description: Choose Flux 2 Klein when speed matters, and route high-resolution or text-heavy work elsewhere.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Image Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 4B to create a fast draft of [subject]. Keep the prompt subject-first and choose a square format.

prompt_templates.title: Polished Product Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein 9B for a polished product image of [product]. Include material, lighting, camera, background, and quality details.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Style Transfer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Flux 2 Klein with up to four aligned reference images. Keep composition stable, change [specific element], and preserve lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Live Iteration Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a fast 4B exploration for three prompt variants. Compare results, then refine the best one with 9B and 25 steps.

output_examples.input: Create a fast product concept for a matte ceramic mug.
output_examples.output: A subject-first prompt plan with a 4B concepting recommendation and a 9B final pass recommendation.

output_examples.input: Make a campaign image match three brand references.
output: A warning to keep all references in one visual style.
A prompt that preserves composition and changes only the requested brand elements.
A note about sending reference assets to RunComfy.

output_examples.output: A model-routing note that Flux 2 Klein may soften typography and GPT Image 2 may fit better.

best_practices: Use 4B for fast exploration and 9B for final detail.
Keep prompts subject-first, concrete, and under the model prompt limit.
Use reference images with consistent style, lighting, and composition.
anti_patterns: Do not request 4K output from Flux 2 Klein.
Do not mix unrelated reference styles in one generation.
Do not put secrets or private data in prompts or reference URLs.

faq.question: Does this skill run Flux 2 Klein locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the RunComfy CLI and hosted Model API.

faq.question: Which variant should I use first?
faq.answer: Use 4B for live concepting. Use 9B for final detail.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents support for up to four reference images on the endpoint.

faq.question: Does it need an API token?
faq.answer: Yes. RunComfy login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN is required for authenticated requests.

faq.question: Is it good for text in images?
faq.answer: It can handle simple typography, but text-heavy work should use GPT Image 2.

faq.question: What data leaves my machine?
faq.answer: Prompts, reference URLs, and generated output requests are sent to RunComfy's service.
